title: UCC § 2-306 — output, requirements, exclusive dealings
summary: The chapter connects variable quantities with good faith and exclusive dealings with efforts obligations.
notes: Structural Polymer applies requirements-contract reasoning. The output problem tests cessation of production. The Wood notes compare the provision’s best-efforts wording to the court’s reasonable-efforts implication. The actual standalone section, comments, and the Wood contract in SEL are missing from this source set.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 107–117. Open assigned page 107.
